text: Hi, Unit 4B here. The kitchen tap has been dripping for two days and it is getting louder.
There is a smell of gas in the hallway of building C, flat 12. Please come now.
Flat 7A, the heating is off again and the baby is cold. I am home after 6pm on weekdays.
My front door lock is stuck, I cannot get out. Unit 2D.
Mice in the cupboard under the sink, 9F. Mornings are fine for access.
Sparks came out of the socket by the bed in 3C and the power is out in the bedroom.
The hallway light on the second floor has been out for a week. Not urgent. Unit 2A.
Water is coming through my ceiling in 5B, the flat above says their bath overflowed.
The washing machine in 6E will not drain. I work nights, so anytime before noon.
Window will not close in 8A and it is freezing. Someone is home all day.
Smoke alarm in 10C keeps beeping even with a new battery. Weekends are best.
Boiler pressure gauge is in the red, flat 1B. I am in until 5pm today.
